**Analysis:**

**Test image observations:**
- Green mango leaf with scattered small-to-medium **black spots/patches** across the surface
- Leaf is otherwise green and intact (not wilted, no margin damage, no brown areas)
- Spots appear superficial (flat coating), irregular in shape and distribution

**Candidate elimination:**
- **Die_Back**: Completely brown/wilted curled leaves — no match
- **Anthracnose**: Brown damaged leaves with dark lesions at margins — no match
- **Bacterial_Canker**: Angular lesions with raised margins on serrated leaves — no match
- **Cutting_Weevil**: Brown crumpled young leaves with stripped shoots — no match
- **Gall_Midge**: Round blister/gall formations (3D raised structures) — no match
- **Powdery_Mildew**: **White** powdery coating — the test image shows **black** spots, not white

**Best match — Sooty_Mould:**
- Reference images show mango leaves with black superficial patches/coating scattered across the green surface — directly matches the test image
- The bottom-right panel of the Sooty_Mould collage is nearly identical: scattered irregular black spots on an otherwise healthy green leaf
- Consistent with the description: "superficial dark mycelium forming black encrustation on leaf surfaces"
